meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: Claude 仍负责统筹,但可以把任务交给本机 Ollama 模型:列出已安装的模型,并指定某个模型生成回答。若开启管理开关,还能拉取、删除、查看模型详情,以及查看内存中已加载的模型。
howto.when: 当你要求用本机 Ollama 模型生成回答,或(开启管理开关后)让它拉取、删除模型时接管。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 它会先列出可用模型,再调用模型生成回答

say.text: 拉取 gemma3:1b 这个模型
say.note: 需已开启管理工具,否则该工具不存在

say.text: 现在内存里加载了哪些 ollama 模型?

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can hand work to the host's local Ollama models: list installed models and have a chosen model generate a reply. With the admin flag on, it can also pull, delete, show and list running models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to answer using a local Ollama model, or (with the admin flag) to pull or delete models.

say_en.text: use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists available models first, then generates the reply
Requires the admin tools flag to be on

say_en.text: which ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
say_en.note: Requires the admin tools flag to be on
